contentBlocks.text: Yesterday you reviewed formal writing's register. Today: the ਲੇਖ (essay)'s three-part structure!

A formal ਲੇਖ has three parts: ਭੂਮਿਕਾ (introduction, introducing the topic), ਵਿਸ਼ਾ-ਵਸਤੂ (body, the main content and ideas), and ਸਿੱਟਾ (conclusion, summarizing and closing). Choose a simple topic you know well (a hobby, a favorite season, a place you enjoy), and write one sentence each for what your ਭੂਮਿਕਾ, ਵਿਸ਼ਾ-ਵਸਤੂ, and ਸਿੱਟਾ would say about it.
You just outlined a real three-part essay structure! Tomorrow we'll learn formal transition words to connect the parts smoothly.

objectives: Name the three parts of a formal ਲੇਖ: ਭੂਮਿਕਾ, ਵਿਸ਼ਾ-ਵਸਤੂ, ਸਿੱਟਾ
Outline a simple topic across all three parts, one sentence each
teacherGuide.facilitationScript:
1. Review yesterday's formal-writing-register work briefly.
2. Introduce the three-part essay structure.
3. Have the child outline a simple topic across all three parts.
4. Complete the worksheet.
5. Preview tomorrow's transition-words lesson.
differentiationTips: Struggling: model the outline with a very simple topic (my favorite food) as a class example before asking for an independent one
Ready for more: ask the child why an essay's ਸਿੱਟਾ shouldn't just repeat the ਭੂਮਿਕਾ word-for-word
This is a foundational structural skill directly reusable for any future formal Punjabi essay the student writes
teacherGuide.answerKey: This is an open-ended outlining activity — check that the child provides one genuine sentence for each of the three parts, and that the ਭੂਮਿਕਾ introduces the topic, the ਵਿਸ਼ਾ-ਵਸਤੂ develops it with real content, and the ਸਿੱਟਾ closes it rather than simply repeating the introduction.
teacherGuide.standardsRationale: Directly addresses this course's formal-writing thread, teaching the standard three-part structure underlying formal essay composition.

generationData.instructions: Outline your topic across the three essay parts.
